purchase.heading: Buy this coffee
purchase.roastedText: We roast your bag after you order and ship within 3 days, so it reaches you fresh.
purchase.storage: Storage tip: keep the bag closed, away from light and heat, and enjoy it within 4 weeks of opening.

brewing.light: Filter or pour-over at 93 to 95 °C, a medium grind and a 1 to 16 ratio brings out the fruit and florals.
brewing.medium: Works in a filter, moka pot or French press. Try a 1 to 15 ratio at 92 °C for caramel and cacao.
brewing.dark: Best as espresso or in a moka pot. Use water just off the boil and stop early to keep the chocolate sweet.

shipping.title: Shipping and
shipping.shipping: Flat shipping of COP 12,000 anywhere in Colombia, free on orders over COP 150,000. Medellín and Urrao 1 to 2 business days, Bogotá 2 to 3, the rest of Colombia 3 to 5 (example times).
shipping.returns: If your bag arrives damaged, write to us within 5 business days and we will replace it. Right of withdrawal (derecho de retracto) and PQRS terms are a placeholder pending legal review.
shipping.payment: Finish your order on WhatsApp. Online payment with PSE, Nequi and cards is coming soon.
